parsed.internal_thinking: Shon rolled an 11, which gives both him and Hadar one wood (עץ). Hadar is sitting at 4 points and every resource she gets now is a massive threat. She's trying to play the 'stuck' card, but she's accumulating resources. I need to keep the table's focus on her so Shon doesn't get tempted to trade her the brick (טיט) or sheep (כבשה) she likely needs to win.
parsed.note_to_self: Hadar gained עץ from the roll of 11. She now has at least 3 עץ and 2 חיטה. She is the immediate threat at 4 VP.
parsed.say_outloud: 11? הדר, עוד עץ לאוסף. שון, נראה לי שהקוביות דווקא בעדה כרגע.
